reviews.text:
We started looking for a place to board our 6-month-old puppy, Hammy, while we were away on a family trip. Meadowlake Pet Resort on Furman immediately stood out because it was close to home, reasonably priced, and had large play areas where she could run and burn off some of her endless puppy energy.

When we brought Hammy in for her daycare evaluation, she actually failed the first one but not because she was aggressive or fearful, but because she was a puppy who just wanted to play, play, play! The staff took the time to explain everything, suggested another evaluation with a different play group, and she passed with flying colors. That experience alone showed us they genuinely care about making sure every dog is placed in the right environment.

Since Hammy is such a high-energy puppy, we also enrolled her in the two-week Stay & Train Ivy League program with Lena, and it was one of the best decisions we’ve made. Not only did Hammy come home with better manners, confidence, and basic obedience, but we also learned so much as owners about dog behavior, communication, and the relationship between us and our pup. Lena was absolutely wonderful.

Since then, Hammy has been going to Meadowlake almost every week for daycare, and she absolutely loves it. The moment we pull into the parking lot, she can’t wait to jump out of the car and completely forgets all of her manners because she’s so excited to see her friends. She comes home exhausted every single time, which tells me she’s had a full day of playing and having fun.

The staff has been incredible. Bri at the front desk is amazing, the boarding supervisor is so kind, and every team member we’ve met has treated Hammy like one of their own. You can genuinely tell they love what they do, and that gives us so much peace of mind.

We did have one unexpected incident during their Annual Pool Paw-ty when Hammy wore down the soft puppy calluses on her feet from running between the pool and the turf. While it was unfortunate, the Meadowlake team was fantastic. They immediately explained how to care for her paws, checked in on her, and reimbursed our veterinary expenses through their Pet Care Promise without any hassle. Accidents can happen anywhere dogs are playing, and what mattered most to us was how professionally and compassionately they handled the situation.

We recently purchased another package of daycare visits, and we can’t wait to bring Hammy back next week. If you’re looking for a place where your dog will be loved, cared for, and come home happily exhausted, I highly recommend Meadowlake Pet Resort on Furman Road.

I’ve used Meadowlake Pet Resort for both training and boarding, and overall I’ve had a very positive experience. The staff is always welcoming, friendly, and professional. From the beginning, they took the time to give me a tour of the accommodations and patiently answered all of my questions, which made me feel comfortable leaving my dog in their care.

I’ve been happy with both the training services and boarding experience, and I would definitely recommend them to other pet owners.

The main reason I’m considering looking at other options is the pricing structure. At around $70 per night, I was disappointed that photo updates or check-ins during my dog’s stay are not included. I also don’t love that extra one-on-one play sessions or group play require additional fees. For the price point, I would personally expect more enrichment activities and updates to already be part of the boarding experience.

That said, the staff and care have always been great, and that’s what keeps me coming back.

We had an amazing experience! This was the very first time our two dogs had ever been to a doggy daycare, and we couldn’t have asked for a better introduction. They offered a free evaluation, so our pups were able to spend the entire day there, which was such a great opportunity.

Everyone was incredibly welcoming and caring—from the front desk staff to the team in the back. When I picked up my dogs, several staff members came over to tell me how well they had done, and it was obvious they had taken the time to get to know them.

The facility was clean, organized, and full of happy dogs that genuinely looked like they were having a great time. My dogs came home completely worn out and went straight to sleep, which tells me they had an exciting, fun-filled day!

Based on this experience, we’ve found our new go-to doggy daycare and boarding facility. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a place where their pets will be loved and well cared for. Thank you for making our first experience such a wonderful one! 🐾💕

Our Margot loves it here! As new dog parents, my daughter and I looked for a place we could feel comfortable and safe with our new family addition. Meadowlake provides that for us. From grooming to overnight care, they are our choice.

Meadowlake always provides exceptional customer service and pet care. Kobe attends daycare, when I needed to go out of town for a Memorial service Meadowlake was where I knew he would be comfortable. We and Kobe adore all the team members, the best parts of my day are seeing how excited Kobe is when he is going to daycare and when we pick him up. I love that the team interacts, plays with all the dogs, and brings out the best in each one. We are so appreciative of the team, Kobe is a silly, funny, loving doodle dog- we know they have helped shape his personality. Kudo's to this amazing team and all the love they pour into our fur babies. If you are looking for day care or a place for your fur baby while you are out of town- just know they will be well cared for at Meadowlake.

I boarded my dog Bear at Meadowlake Pet Resort this week. His bath and de-shedding treatment was excellent, and he looked great when I picked him up. The staff was friendly and professional.

My only suggestion would be more updates during his stay so owners know how their pets are doing day to day. Overall, a good experience

Today was a return to Meadowlake with Neferkitti and Calico  being prepared for an extended stay. I think they like it here as went right in. Staff are attentive  and friendly. Denise and Emily showed empathy  for all my concerns as the two cats are housed together .
This little girl takes a while to warm up to others but she got a chance to bond and have a great stay!

These people are amazing with dogs.
My two flying out of the car to go into this place.
They absolutely love to be in daycare
The person who takes care of them is the most dog loving person I have ever met.
Absolutely highly recommend  this place to ant dog owner.
Daisey enjoyed her stay with you guys. The pictures were awesome that we were sent each day. We will choose Meadowlake again for her stay…
Great place to leave your pet. My cat stays there 3 to 4 times a year. she is well taken care of and staff is very friendly.

I used Meadowlake 288 during the New Years holiday for the first time (12/30/2025 - 1/3 /2026). It was my dog’s first time having been at a boarding facility. I had some concerns (at the time) from the get go about it being his first experience - they assured me he would be in good care.

The tour I got was great. The facility was organized, the staff I came into contact with friendly. I am giving two stars only for the communication of the staff every time I checked on my dog.

When I picked up my dog he had a rasp, what ended up being kennel cough. Also upon pick up he REEKED. He smelled so bad, like he had been put into a filthy kennel, maybe snuggled with other dogs covered in feces. Additionally I was not appreciative of how he was acting. He was weirded out. I am very displeased with  his behavior and on edge. I picked him up on a Saturday morning. Tuesday he was scheduled for neuter, the surgery had to be cancelled, his kennel cough was very pronounced.

I called the facility and spoke with Maggie. I did inform her that my dog had kennel cough. He was healthy prior to being dropped off, but now sick after being in their care. I did request that they make this right. I was informed they would cover vet expenses only. Vet invoices were requested. Those were submitted. Now I have to supposedly wait for a mailed check to reimburse me for my vet expenses. I submitted my invoices 1/6/2026.

I paid $360 for my dog to obviously be in distress, become filthy, and get kennel cough. And then an additional $120 for vet bills that I have yet to get refunded.

I should be refunded for the $360 as well.

I do not recommend this facility.

First time taking my pup Hazel to the groomers with Meadowlake on 288 and to sum it all up, Melissa did amazing! My little poodle was very matted and honestly thought she would have to be shaved but that wasn’t the case. Melissa was able to style her to look like teddy bear and her little short tail was also styled beautifully. I appreciate the care and comfort given to Hazel. We will be back as it’s not only convenient from where we live, but the salon is clean, has friendly staff, and most importantly welcoming. Happiest of holidays and see y’all soon! -Amaan and Leslie
THE BEST! The staff likes their job and it shows. Everyone was extremely friendly and informative. It was my first time boarding and I will be going back. Thank you!!!! Brim loved it

Credit card details should never be mixed up. I don’t understand how somebody else’s card information got saved to my profile. I agreed to pay using the card on file thinking it was mine, but it turned out not to be. I’ll take some blame because I should know my card number by heart, but at the same time how does this kinda mistake happen? I really like you guys (personality wise you’re great), but this is not the first mistake you’ve made. Letting my dog slip through the kennel door with no leash, her not being 100% dry after her grooming, etc. Those I’ll excuse, but this is not good.
